# Design

Eight packages. protocol: NDJSON framing and envelopes shared by host, runner and wb. core: the engine (config, store, audit, cgroups, rootfs and runtime builders, launch chain, netns and proxy, seccomp, sandbox state machine, manager, per-sandbox supervisor, broker). runner: the in-box supervisor, PID 2 under bwrap, serving a unix socket at /run/workbox/runner.sock for both wb and the host. wb: the agent CLI. server, sdk, mcp, cli: the harness surfaces over core.
